children.name: text
children: Add a new clause 1.3.6 as follows: "If any provision of this Sub-Contract is declared invalid, unenforceable or illegal by the courts of any jurisdiction to which it is subject, such invalidity, unenforceability or illegality shall not prejudice or affect the validity, enforceability or legality of the remaining provisions of this Sub-Contract."

children.name: text
children: Add a new clause 2.3A as follows:

"The Sub-Contractor acknowledges that failure by the Sub-Contractor to comply with the provisions of clause 2.3 may cause delay and/or disruption to the Main Contract Works and/or any part thereof and/or may cause the Contractor to suffer costs, loss and/or damage. The Sub-Contractor shall plan, carry out and complete the Sub-Contract Works and any Section in accordance with the Sub-Contract and will not delay, disrupt or contribute to any delay or disruption to any part of the Main Contract Works due to its own default. Provided that the Contractor shall keep the Sub-Contractor informed of the progress of the Main Contract Works and shall co-ordinate them to allow the Sub-Contractor to proceed in accordance with the Sub-Contractors Programme."

children.name: text
children: Add a new clause 2.3B as follows: "Without prejudice to any other rights and remedies of the Contractor, if actual progress of the Sub-Contract Works or any Section does not comply with clause 2.3 due to the default of the Sub-Contractor, then the Contractor shall be entitled to require the Sub-Contractor to produce a revised programme and proposals to ensure completion of the Sub-Contract Works or any Section in accordance with clause 2.3."

children.name: text
children: Add a new clause 2.13.1 as follows:

“The Sub-Contractor has inspected the physical and other site conditions (conditions as would be discoverable upon inspection as at the date of this Sub-Contract and other conditions external to but affecting the Site including the land and structures adjacent to the Site, to the extent they relate to the Sub-Contract Works and/or are likely to affect the manner in which the Sub-Contract Works may be performed and has fully acquainted himself with the same and has reviewed all information issued to him as to risks, contingencies and related circumstances which may influence or affect the carrying out and completion of the Sub-Contract Works, including the means of access and facilities for storage and delivery of plant, materials and Sub-Contractor’s equipment. No failure on the part of the Sub-Contractor to discover, review or foresee any such conditions, to the extent that they were issued for review, reasonably discoverable or foreseeable, shall entitle the Sub-Contractor to an adjustment to the Sub-Contract Sum or to an extension of time. Subject to clause 2.10, the Sub-Contractor shall be entitled to rely upon any survey, report or other document prepared by or on behalf of the Contractor and which forms part of this Sub-Contract regarding any such matter as is referred to in this clause as to the accuracy of any such survey, report or document or for any representation or statement contained therein, whether made negligently or otherwise save where the Sub-Contractor’s obligations of performance under this Sub-Contract include a requirement to consider and/or verify the accuracy or completeness of and/or to identify any relevant discrepancies within or between any such survey, report or document.”

children.name: text
children: Add a new clause 2.13.2 as follows:

“Without prejudice to the Sub-Contractor’s other obligations under this Sub-Contract, to the extent that the Sub-Contractor is responsible for selection of goods and materials, the Sub-Contractor warrants that it has not used, specified for use or permitted the use and shall not use, specify for use or permit the use in the Sub-Contractor’s Works any Prohibited Materials. In the event the Sub-Contractor becomes aware that any Prohibited Materials or combinations of Prohibited Materials have been or may be used in the Development the Sub-Contractor shall immediately notify the Contractor.”

children.name: text
children: Add a new clause 2.13.3 as follows:

“The Sub-Contractor will not vary, amend, change, add to or alter the Sub-Contract Works or any part thereof as described in the Sub-Contract Documents without first obtaining the prior written approval of the Contractor. In seeking the written approval of the Contractor, the Sub-Contractor shall provide to the Contractor adequate details of the proposed variation, amendment, change, addition or alteration including relevant performance and qualitative criteria in relation to any materials and highlighting and detailing on any documents the nature of the proposed variation, amendment, addition or alteration. Any additional cost to or delay in the Sub-Contract Works and/or the Main Contract Works arising out of any such variation, amendment, change, addition or alteration shall be borne by the Sub-Contractor unless such variation, amendment, change, addition or alteration is as a result of an instruction from the Employer or Contractor which is not due to any discrepancy or omission caused by the Sub-Contractor.”

children.name: text
children: Add a new clause 2.14 as follows:

“The Sub-Contractor shall not during the period of its employment under this Sub-Contract or at any time after the expiry or termination of this Sub-Contract or of the Sub-Contractor’s employment hereunder disclose to any person (other than Sub-Contractor’s Persons in the proper course of their duties relative to this Sub-Contract and the Sub-Contractor’s legal or other advisors, and law enforcement or other regulatory bodies insofar as the Sub-Contractor is required by law) any information not already in the public domain relating to this Sub-Contract, the Sub-Contract Works and/or the Development. The Sub-Contractor shall ensure that any persons having access to such information are aware of these obligations and are similarly bound by them.”

children.name: text
children: "No Site Materials delivered to the Main Contract Works or the Sub-Contract Works shall be The Employer’s Agentd without the Contractors written consent. Any materials and goods whether delivered to the Site or otherwise, the value of which is included in an Interim Payment under the Main Contract, or for which payment has been made by the Contractor to the Sub-Contractor before their value is included in any Interim Payment under the Main Contract, or on delivery to the Site, whichever first occurs, shall, be and become the property of the Contractor. The Sub-Contractor shall indemnify the Contractor from and against any expense, liability, loss, claim, cost or proceedings whatsoever arising from any failure to pass to the Contractor a complete and unencumbered title in any materials or goods. The value under the Sub-Contract of all materials and goods for which title is transferred pursuant to this clause, and for which the Sub-Contractor has not previously received payment from the Contractor, shall become due and included for payment in the next interim Payment Notice. The Contractor shall be liable to the Sub-Contractor for the full unpaid value of any such property until such payment is made."

children: The Subcontractor will maintain adequate and appropriately qualified management and supervisory staff to ensure that the Subcontract Works are effectively administered and safely managed in accordance with prevalent legislation and industry good practice, provided.

children: Where the Subcontractor has been instructed in writing by the Contractor to carry out any additional or substitute work on a daywork basis the Subcontractor shall be paid for such work in accordance with the provisions of the Subcontractor and at the rates and prices set out in this daywork schedule; provided always that payment on a daywork basis is conditional upon:
The Subcontractor having given the Contractor reasonable notice of the commencement of any work for which the Subcontractor intends to seek payment on a daywork basis.

The Subcontractor maintaining contemporary records (daywork sheets) of all resources engaged upon the instructed daywork (including the names and site pass/NI No's of all operatives) and delivering such records to the Contractor's Project Manager or Quantity Surveyor each day during the currency of the instructed daywork for endorsement or comment.

NB. For the avoidance of endorsement of any daywork sheet by the Contractor will constitute verification of resource expenditure only. Daywork hours must be recorded net (exclusive of all meal/refreshments breaks and travel time).

Endorsed daywork sheets together with any further substantive information shall be included within the Subcontractor's interim application for payment, with the daywork sheets fully priced, extended and totalled prior to submission. Further, all daywork sheets shall be specifically referenced to the Contractor's instruction.

All labour rates herein are fully inclusive of all direct and indirect costs including but not restricted to the Subcontractor's overheads and profit, head office charges, site management, supervision and other preliminary costs, PPE, small tools and consumables, all direct and indirect employee costs and all other charges, and shall not be subject to any further adjustment. All rates included herein are fixed and firm for the duration of the Works.

The Subcontractor labour rates shall include for the amount of wages to be paid to the work people inclusive of all overheads and profits and such extra payments of differentials as are paid in respect of staff responsibility, discomfort, inconvenience and risk in accordance with the rules and awards of the recognised wage fixing bodies of the trades concerned.

The Subcontractor labour rates shall include for the amount of wages to be paid to the work people inclusive of all overheads and profits and such extra payments of differentials as are paid in respect of staff responsibility, discomfort, inconvenience and risk in accordance with the rules and awards of the recognised wage fixing bodies of the trades concerned.

Where the Subcontractoris instructed to supply materials to execute daywork the Subcontractor shall be reimbursed the actual and reasonable net cost of the material, plus the additional percentage stated herein. For the avoidance of doubt the noted additional percentage shall cater for all direct and indirect costs associated with the supply of the materials, including but not restricted to the Subcontractor's overheads and profit, all delivery, off-loading and further handling costs, the disposal of packaging and arisings associated with the materials from site and any further statutory or other costs.
The Subcontractor must insert below, various categories of craftsmen, labourers, apprentices, etc., he proposes to use, and the hourly rates, calculated as before described.
